releases.notes:
## 0.2.0

---

Breaking
- Packages are now feature-first (`feature.dist`) instead of dist-first (`dist.feature`)
- Plural package names renamed to singular
- FoundryEngine split into feature-specific mods; update your dependencies accordingly
- Migration: find-and-replace old package paths in imports, mixin configs and scripts

---

Added
- Additional mods for some features.

---

Fixed
- Crash from duplicate items in the bundle creative tab
- Some packet limits increased

---

Changed
- Updated NeoForge to the latest version
